objectives: Synthesize the published data on helminth-derived immunomodulatory peptides/polypeptides/proteins (HDIPs), with a focus on determining the extent to which they modulate the inflammatory response in in vitro cellular models of inflammation.
inclusion_criteria: Inclusion criteria: (1) original research study, (2) HDIPs, (3) cellular inflammatory model.
exclusion_criteria: Exclusion criteria: (1) review article, (2) not helminth-derived, (3) undefined helminth-derived molecule, (4) not peptide/polypeptide/protein helminth-derived molecule, (5) not tested in inflammatory model, and (6) not peer-reviewed or redacted. Additional full-text exclusions were: (7) no cytokine measure, (8) no appropriate control, and (9) not in a cellular (in vitro) model.
pmid_query: helminth AND secret* AND (immunomod* OR immunosup* OR antiinflam*)
selection_evidence: Results and the PRISMA flow diagram report 79 included articles total, comprising 63 articles after full-text screening plus 16 added from reference lists. Table 1 is explicitly titled as the studies included in the review, and the reference list contains a continuous block of study citations from ref 14 through ref 92. That contiguous block contains exactly 79 references (92 - 14 + 1 = 79), matching the reported included-study count. Refs 93 onward are supporting/background citations rather than the included-study set. This makes refs 14-92 the best-supported included-study list.
notes:
The exact numbered study list is inferred from the convergence of Table 1, Results/PRISMA counts, and the main reference list. Supplemental materials did not provide a clearer numbered alternative; the supplementary Excel file is cited as the detailed companion to Table 1. An unrelated PDF present under supplemental (`supp_1_15.pdf`) was not used.
